title: Envisioning Narrative Intelligence: A Creative Visual Storytelling Anthology

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative thematic analysis and close reading of crowdsourced human-authored stories to examine how authors interpreted visual language cues (e.g., Arabic text) and the subsequent cultural assumptions and narratives they fabricated.

Qualitative thematic analysis and close reading of visual stories to evaluate the casting of characters, specifically identifying class-based prejudices such as stereotyping construction workers as lazy or portraying people experiencing housing insecurity as thieves and antagonistic threats.

Qualitative thematic analysis and close reading of human-authored stories to observe the casting of characters, highlighting instances where women were cast in stereotypical or unfavorable roles, such as incompetent or nagging managers.
